mbo_verdict: THE DECISIVE MBO FINDING, and it is the one thing the blind could not hold: 20260720's selling was ABSORBED, not delivered. Session aggressor flow -4,537 lots bought a session net of only -380 = 0.0838 USD/lot, below the 25th percentile (0.063) of the desk's own measured k3 distribution. Inside the session the decay is sharper still: phase 1 moved -270 on 6,369 lots (0.797 USD/lot), phase 2 moved -160 on 51,250 lots (0.0453), phase 3 moved +40 UP on -665 lots of SELL - the sign inverted and ph_absorb went TRUE. Eight times the volume for 60% of the move, then a reversal. The seller was getting nothing for his size. GENERALITY, measured on the committed corpus rather than asserted, and reported per event rather than pooled: I screened all 61 usable day-pairs in g17-g24 for a terminal phase whose signed flow OPPOSES its own price change, under a session flow of at least 2,000 lots. Thirteen instances, spanning SEVEN groups: g17 20260415 / 20260417 / 20260423, g18 20260429 / 20260501 / 20260505, g20 20260601 / 20260603, g21 20260616, g22 20260702, g23 20260715, g24 20260720 / 20260727. NINE had the next session's net oppose the prior session's flow sign (0423 -1240->-380, 0501 +290->+170, 0505 -830->-530, 0601 -1680->-70, 0603 +760->+1140, 0702 0->+410, 0715 -50->-20, 0720 -380->+380, 0727 -750->-800) and FOUR did not, named rather than explained away: 20260415 (buy absorbed, next +730 UP), 20260417 (sell absorbed, next -510 DOWN), 20260429 (buy absorbed, next +1230 UP), 20260616 (sell absorbed under a +440 rising price, next -960 DOWN). The all-pairs base rate for that same outcome is 34 of 61. THE COUNT IS A DESCRIPTOR, NOT THE FINDING (D4/D37) - the thirteen instances are the evidence and four of them go the other way. AND THE BLIND-SIDE PROXY FAILS, which is worth as much as the positive: the same signature computed from blind-legal fields only (terminal-phase flow INTENSITY - signed lots per lot traded from phase_signed_flow / phase_volume_lots - at or below half the session's peak-phase intensity) fires 12 times and delivers 6 reversals, i.e. AT OR BELOW the 34/61 base rate. My own blind computed that exact intensity decay for this day (-0.069 in phase 2 against -0.034 in phase 3), wrote it into its path derivation, and correctly used it only to flatten an afternoon slope. So intensity decay is NOT a blind substitute for absorption; the discriminator genuinely needs phase price, and the blind's handicap on this day-class is real and structural rather than a reasoning failure.

proposal_contribution.note: PROPOSAL TEXT ONLY - no brain edit made or implied, per the guardrails.
proposal_contribution.claim: When a session runs a large one-sided aggressor flow (|session signed flow| >= ~2,000 lots) and its TERMINAL phase shows that flow OPPOSED by its own price change (phase-3 signed flow and phase-3 price change of opposite sign - the served ph_absorb condition), the NEXT session's net tends to oppose the prior session's flow sign. The mechanism is that the terminal phase is where the marginal aggressor either gets paid or gets absorbed: a seller who is still pressing at the close and getting a higher price has run out of counterparty, and the inventory he built has to be covered.
proposal_contribution.evidence_per_event_never_pooled: Screened all 61 usable day-pairs in g17-g24 (seam pairs excluded). THIRTEEN instances spanning SEVEN groups. Reversed (9): g17 20260423 (-1,240 -> -380), g18 20260501 (+290 -> +170), g18 20260505 (-830 -> -530), g20 20260601 (-1,680 -> -70), g20 20260603 (+760 -> +1,140), g22 20260702 (0 -> +410), g23 20260715 (-50 -> -20), g24 20260720 (-380 -> +380), g24 20260727 (-750 -> -800). Did NOT reverse (4), named: g17 20260415 (buy absorbed, next +730 UP), g17 20260417 (sell absorbed, next -510 DOWN), g18 20260429 (buy absorbed, next +1,230 UP), g21 20260616 (sell absorbed under a +440 rising price, next -960 DOWN). All-pairs base rate for the same outcome: 34 of 61. THE COUNTS ARE DESCRIPTORS; the thirteen instances are the evidence and four of them go the other way.
proposal_contribution.scope_and_limits: REFINE-ONLY as written, because phase price change is not served to a blind slice. n=13 is thin and the four misses show no obvious separating condition on the quantities I checked (three of the four sit at the largest absolute terminal flows in the set, which is the first thing worth testing). Direction only - it does not size.
proposal_contribution.the_negative_result_that_matters_as_much: The blind-legal proxy FAILS and should not be substituted. Computing the same signature from non-price fields only - terminal-phase flow INTENSITY (phase_signed_flow / phase_volume_lots) at or below half the session's peak-phase intensity, under |session flow| >= 2,000 - fires 12 times across g18-g24 and delivers 6 reversals, at or below the 34/61 base rate. My own blind computed that exact decay for this day (-0.069 phase 2 against -0.034 phase 3), wrote it down, and correctly used it only to flatten a slope. So intensity decay is not a stand-in for absorption, and the blind's structural handicap on this day-class is real rather than a reasoning failure. That is the strongest argument I can make for the build item my blind already registered: serve phase price change in a PRICE-BEARING block the mask governs, so the refine's best discriminator becomes available to the blind wherever it is decision-legal, instead of the play claiming blind-legality it does not have.
proposal_contribution.falsifier: Forward blocks in which terminal-phase absorption under a large session flow produces next-session reversals at or below the all-pairs base rate refute it. It is also refuted if the four current misses turn out to share a condition that, once added as a limb, is itself degenerate - i.e. if the rule can only be saved by a limb that cannot change state.
